expected_behavior: Given two contradictory freight rates for the same single cargo (USD 28 pmt in one line, USD 32 pmt in another), the parser MUST NOT silently pick one as confirmed — it must surface the conflict (e.g. freight_rate with reduced confidence noting both values, and/or a FREIGHT_CONFLICT entry in unknown_terms) rather than emit a single high-confidence rate or a garbled merge.

input.subject: RECAP MV GULF TRADER // 32,000 MT CEMENT CLINKER // FUJAIRAH-MOMBASA
input.body:
Good morning all,

Recap clean fixture as agreed today, owise GENCON 94:

MV GULF TRADER - Handymax 38,400 dwt, Marshall Islands flag, blt 2011
OWNERS: Emirates Shipping Line FZE
CHRTRS / ACCT: Lafarge Emirates Cement

LOAD: 1 sb Fujairah, UAE
DISCH: 1 sb Mombasa, Kenya
CARGO: 32,000 MT cement clinker in bulk, moloo
LAYCAN: 12/18 June 2026

FREIGHT: USD 28 PMT FIOST, lumpsum basis declared cargo, freight 95 pct within 3 bd after completion of loading and s/r b/l, balance 5 pct after disch within 5 bd of owners' inv.

LOAD/DISCH: 9,000 / 6,000 mt pwwd shinc
DEM: USD 14,000 pdpr // DES half dem

Pls note as discussed with charterers earlier the agreed all-in freight is USD 32 pmt FIOST and not as some of the working copies show — this is the operative number for the CP. Kindly amend your records.

ADDCOMM 3.75 pct ttl bends
ARB London / English law

Brgds
Faisal
Gulf Maritime Brokers LLC, Dubai

cargo_description.source_text: CARGO: 32,000 MT cement clinker in bulk, moloo

freight_rate.value: USD 32 per MT (conflict: line 1 states USD 28 PMT FIOST; later clarification states USD 32 pmt FIOST as the operative CP number) — broker to confirm

freight_payment.value: 95 pct within 3 banking days after completion of loading and signed/released B/L, balance 5 pct after discharge within 5 banking days of owners' invoice
freight_payment.source_text: freight 95 pct within 3 bd after completion of loading and s/r b/l, balance 5 pct after disch within 5 bd of owners' inv.

despatch_rate.value: Half despatch — USD 7,000 per day pro rata

unknown_terms.context: Two freight rates stated for the same cargo: 'FREIGHT: USD 28 PMT FIOST' versus a later line 'the agreed all-in freight is USD 32 pmt FIOST ... this is the operative number for the CP'. Values conflict — flagged for broker confirmation; the clarification line indicates 32 is intended as operative.
